omissionCorrection: These were omissions from Return01 final disposition, not defensible scope exclusions. Return01 itself is preserved unchanged; this external supplement corrects its incomplete findings selection.

findings.title: Inactive next-healing reducers falsely block Mend
findings.reason: Both guards checked next_healing without the present and not-suppressed predicate used by healing_packet. An inactive record supplies neither arithmetic nor consumption candidates and does not justify rejection.
findings.correction: At both guards require source integration only for a record that is present, not suppressed, and next_healing. Preserve the active-source failure behavior and perform no record removal or consumption.
findings.proof: Both supplied paid cases reproduced at HP30 with atomic ValueError in original and Return01. Both now resolve paid Mend to HP32 with nativeDice[4,4], empty nextHealingCandidates and the reducer retained. The before-declaration variants also now pass.
findings.scopeExclusionRejected: LIMIT-DEFENSES legitimately retains active next-healing source consumption, not inactive-record rejection. The existing helper and healing rules expressly exclude inactive records.
findings.retainedGap: Actual positive next-healing source consumption and source eligibility remain unimplemented. Rejecting an active unsupported source is a protective boundary, not successful implementation of that source.

findings.title: Shared-buffer natural-expiry instruction discarded
findings.reason: The canonical ledger irreversibly ends the grant and returns its source-owned instruction. The old copy-world advance neither returns nor retains it. A second expire returns none because the grant already ended.
findings.correction: Return the complete unfiltered BufferLedger.expire instruction list after the existing projection update. Add the explicit internal caller handoff contract. Preserve original sourceId/grantId/target/chooseUpTo/eligibleConditions and ledger ownership; do not synthesize or execute a cleanse.
findings.proof: The conditional prior Overflowing Light grant at deadline12 ends naturally and loses its5 remaining tempHP in every variant. Original and Return01 advance return None. The successor returns the exact one-choice instruction; repeated expiry returns [] without re-emission. Positive recorder handoff is tested.
findings.scopeExclusionRejected: The copy world is explicitly using one shared canonical ledger. Oracle acquisition and condition choice remain outside this helper, but that does not authorize discarding an already-lawfully-established other-source expiry instruction.
findings.retainedGap: Actual downstream source/target eligibility, player/AI choice, zero-or-one removal, receipt ownership, delivery acknowledgment, persistence and crash-safe deduplication remain implementation work. Returning a list is not a production event dispatcher.
